title: Ada and the Signal
author: Ines Nystrom
blurb: Juniper Fairweather, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
